d: The Suprema XPass 2 RFID Reader is a compact outdoor access control reader supporting dual-frequency RFID (125 kHz & 13.56 MHz) and mobile credentials via NFC/BLE. It offers high durability with IP65/IP67 weatherproof and IK08 vandal-resistant protection, making it ideal for harsh environments. The device supports TCP/IP, RS-485 (OSDP), and Wiegand communication, with PoE capability and large user/event capacity for secure access management.
